commitResults.messageTitle: Describe saving through a temporary file in the guides
commitResults.messageBody:
Since #208, a save writes the team to a temporary file beside the
data file and moves it into place only after the write succeeds, so a
failed save leaves the previous data file unchanged. The UG still said
a failed save may leave the file empty or partially written, and the
DG still said the file is written directly with `Files.write`.

Let's describe the temporary file and atomic move in the DG, say in
the UG that the last saved team is kept, and note that a failed first
save can leave the empty file created before it. Add a DG manual test
that a failed save leaves the data file unchanged.

Fixes #212

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix DG passages that no longer match the product
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG expected `j/010` to be rejected, but leading zeros are dropped
and the player is added with jersey number 10. UC03 and the pasted
separators test still said `tag` replaces a player's tags, although it
now adds to them. The Storage section also did not say that the
temporary file needs a writable folder, or that preferences are still
saved directly.

Let's use the out-of-range `j/0100` in the invalid-add test, describe
adding labels in UC03, and expect Captain and Trial after the pasted
`tag` command. UC03 now reports no change when the player already has
every label, and only clearing can remove a player from a category
filter. Add the folder and preferences notes to the Storage section.

Fixes #209
Fixes #210
Fixes #211

commitResults.messageTitle: Reset the sort in the DG sorting test setup
commitResults.messageBody:
The sorting tests say to re-run the setup before each row, but the
setup starts with `clear` only, which does not reset an active sort.
After a row that sorts, the setup's indexed commands hit the wrong
players, e.g. `injury 1` marks Bob instead of Amy.

Let's add `list` after `clear`, as the other DG test setups do.

Fixes #215
Reset the sort in the DG sorting test setup

commitResults.messageTitle: Acknowledge the team's use of AI tools in the DG
commitResults.messageBody:
The course's Policy on reuse asks teams that used AI tools widely to
state which tools were used and how, in the DG under Acknowledgements.
The team used OpenAI and Anthropic tools throughout the project, but
the section did not mention them.

Let's list the tools and what they were used for, and state that all
AI-generated code, tests and documentation were reviewed, tested and
edited by team members before being merged.

Fixes #217

commitResults.messageTitle: Preserve the roster when a save fails
commitResults.messageBody:
Stage roster JSON beside the data file and replace it atomically only
after the write succeeds. Preserve permissions and symbolic-link targets
without changing shared file writes or preference storage.

Cover partial writes, retry, first save, permissions, symbolic links and
invalid target paths with focused regression tests.
Fix partial roster saves and Apple Silicon startup
